name: tilttek/table-safety-bundle
description: tilttek/table-safety in Symfony: screens where players set lines and veils and raise signals, a game master's screen with live alerts, anonymous by default.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the tables of the safety tools to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/paged-media: For the printable cards of a table as a PDF: the X-card, the sheet of the lines and veils and that of the consent checklist
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a participant's answers, stars and wishes and named signals with the rest of their account
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Card, Badge, Button and Alert the screens are built of, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/console: For the command that purges the signals older than the retention
suggest.symfony/mercure-bundle: For the hub each signal is pushed to and the authorization cookie of the viewers
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: For the controller that sends the signals in the background and announces each new one
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the screens, built of the recipes of a kit of the Symfony UX Toolkit
